name: Cass County, ND
findings: Cass County has 678 nonprofit organizations. 326 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 270 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Cass County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Economic development organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 18 economic development organizations here list membership, compared with about 8 in similar places of this size.
